stemMd:
The archive opened a reading room in the old station ______ a room overlooking the platforms—so visitors could consult documents near the place where many of them had been created.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The phrase a room overlooking the platforms interrupts the main sentence and is closed by a dash. A matching opening dash after building correctly marks the parenthetical material.

distractorRationale.b: The inserted noun phrase is not an independent clause.
distractorRationale.a: A colon does not pair with the later dash to delimit this parenthetical phrase.
distractorRationale.d: The closing dash calls for a matching opening dash around the interruption.
